summary_1line: After Parasurama departs, Dasaratha returns triumphantly to Ayodhya with the princes and brides, and Rama begins a virtuous, peaceful life with Sita.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Dasaratha rides a bannered chariot into Ayodhya as flower-strewn streets and cheering citizens welcome the returning princes and their brides.
Queen Kaushalya, Sumitra, and Kaikeyi greet Sita, Urmila, and the other brides with garlands and sandalwood in the shining white palace.
Rama and Sita sit together peacefully in their palace, their gentle affection mirroring Vishnu and Lakshmi.
